title: Solid site menu (no glass lag)
description:
The top-right Menu panel is solid again instead of translucent glass over the video/PACP overlays. Hover-open, backdrop blur, and staggered item animations are removed so the menu opens on click and feels snappy.

Who is affected: PipeShare users on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Site menu panel uses a solid opaque background (no see-through glass).
Removed backdrop blur and staggered item animations that lagged over video.
Menu opens on click/tap only; outside click closes it.
